exclusionClasses.rfc-2606-placeholder-host: RFC 2606/3731 documentation placeholder; never a real destination.
exclusionClasses.loopback-or-private-address: Loopback, link-local, or RFC 1918 private address; intra-deployment, not outbound.
exclusionClasses.single-label-internal-address: Single-label internal/coordination hostname (e.g. container service names); not an internet host.
exclusionClasses.unrecorded-scheme: Scheme outside the recorded set (mail/data/extension schemes etc.); not an outbound network call of the package surface.
exclusionClasses.dynamic-userinfo-expression: Interpolated credential/userinfo authority segment before a dynamic host; carries no static host label.
